import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate target
y = train["admitted"]
X = train.drop(columns=["admitted"])
X_test = test.drop(columns=["admitted"], errors="ignore")

# Identify categorical and numerical columns
categorical_cols = [
    "disability_status",
    "first_generation",
    "gender",
    "race",
    "region",
    "socioeconomic_status",
    "urban_rural",
]
numerical_cols = [c for c in X.columns if c not in categorical_cols]

# One-hot encode categoricals
X = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=categorical_cols, drop_first=True)
X_test = pd.get_dummies(X_test, columns=categorical_cols, drop_first=True)

# Align train/test columns
X, X_test = X.align(X_test, join="left", axis=1, fill_value=0)

# Scale numerical features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X[numerical_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(X[numerical_cols])
X_test[numerical_cols] = scaler.transform(X_test[numerical_cols])

# Split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Train logistic regression
model = LogisticRegression(solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_pred = model.predict(X_val)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")

# Retrain on full data and predict test set
model.fit(X, y)
test_preds = model.predict(X_test).astype(int)

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

    "socioeconomic_status",
    "urban_rural",
]

    [
        ("num", StandardScaler(), numerical_features),
        ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), categorical_features),

)

)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from scipy.stats import randint
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features and target
X = train.drop("admitted", axis=1)
y = train["admitted"]
X_test = test.copy()

# Identify categorical columns
cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

# Ordinal encode categoricals
oe = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown="use_encoded_value", unknown_value=-1)
X[cat_cols] = oe.fit_transform(X[cat_cols])
X_test[cat_cols] = oe.transform(X_test[cat_cols])

# Ensure numeric dtypes
X = X.astype(float)
X_test = X_test.astype(float)

# Set up stratified CV
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Hyperparameter distributions for LightGBM
param_dist = {
    "num_leaves": randint(20, 150),
    "n_estimators": randint(100, 500),
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
    "max_depth": [-1] + list(range(3, 16)),
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
}

# Initialize LightGBM
lgb = LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)

# Randomized search
rs = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=20,
    scoring="accuracy",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    refit=True,
)
# Fit with native categorical support
rs.fit(X, y, categorical_feature=cat_cols)

# Print best CV accuracy
print(f"Best CV accuracy: {rs.best_score_:.4f}")
print("Best parameters:", rs.best_params_)

# Retrain on full training data (already refit) and predict on test
best_model = rs.best_estimator_
preds_test = best_model.predict(X_test).astype(int)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": preds_test})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, RandomizedSearchCV, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, VotingClassifier
from scipy.stats import randint
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features and target
X = train.drop("admitted", axis=1)
y = train["admitted"]

# One-hot encode categorical variables
cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()
X_enc = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=cat_cols)
X_test = test.drop("admitted", axis=1) if "admitted" in test.columns else test.copy()
X_test_enc = pd.get_dummies(
    X_test, columns=X_test.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns
)
X_test_enc = X_test_enc.reindex(columns=X_enc.columns, fill_value=0)

# Stratified CV
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Hyperparameter distributions for LightGBM
param_dist = {
    "num_leaves": randint(20, 150),
    "n_estimators": randint(100, 500),
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
    "max_depth": [-1] + list(range(3, 16)),
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
}

# Tune LightGBM
lgb = LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
rs = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=20,
    scoring="accuracy",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    refit=True,
)
rs.fit(X_enc, y)
best_lgb = rs.best_estimator_
print(f"Best LightGBM CV accuracy: {rs.best_score_:.4f}")

# Build soft-voting ensemble with RandomForest
rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
ensemble = VotingClassifier(
    estimators=[("lgb", best_lgb), ("rf", rf)], voting="soft", weights=[2, 1], n_jobs=-1
)

# Evaluate ensemble with CV
ensemble_scores = cross_val_score(
    ensemble, X_enc, y, cv=cv, scoring="accuracy", n_jobs=-1
)
print(f"Voting ensemble CV accuracy: {ensemble_scores.mean():.4f}")

# Retrain ensemble on full data and predict on test
ensemble.fit(X_enc, y)
preds_test = ensemble.predict(X_test_enc).astype(int)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": preds_test})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

)

X_test[cat_cols] = oe.transform(X_test[cat_cols])

# Identify numeric and categorical columns
num_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

# Create pairwise interaction features for numeric columns
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False)
X_num_inter = pd.DataFrame(
    poly.fit_transform(X[num_cols]),
    columns=poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols),
    index=X.index,
)
X_test_num_inter = pd.DataFrame(
    poly.transform(X_test[num_cols]),
    columns=poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols),
    index=X_test.index,
)

# Append interaction features
X_aug = pd.concat([X, X_num_inter], axis=1)
X_test_aug = pd.concat([X_test, X_test_num_inter], axis=1)

# One-hot encode categorical variables

X[cat_cols] = oe.fit_transform(X[cat_cols])
X_test[cat_cols] = oe.transform(X_test[cat_cols])

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from scipy.stats import randint
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features and target
X = train.drop("admitted", axis=1)
y = train["admitted"]
X_test = test.copy()

# Identify numeric and categorical columns
num_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

# Generate polynomial features for numeric variables (degree=2)
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=False, include_bias=False)
X_num_poly = poly.fit_transform(X[num_cols])
X_test_num_poly = poly.transform(X_test[num_cols])
poly_feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols)

# Create DataFrames for poly features
X_num_poly_df = pd.DataFrame(X_num_poly, columns=poly_feature_names, index=X.index)
X_test_num_poly_df = pd.DataFrame(
    X_test_num_poly, columns=poly_feature_names, index=X_test.index
)

# One-hot encode categorical variables
X_cat = pd.get_dummies(X[cat_cols], drop_first=False)
X_test_cat = pd.get_dummies(X_test[cat_cols], drop_first=False)

# Align categorical features between train and test
X_test_cat = X_test_cat.reindex(columns=X_cat.columns, fill_value=0)

# Combine poly numeric and categorical features
X_enc = pd.concat([X_num_poly_df, X_cat], axis=1)
X_test_enc = pd.concat([X_test_num_poly_df, X_test_cat], axis=1)

# Set up stratified CV
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Hyperparameter distributions for LightGBM
param_dist = {
    "num_leaves": randint(20, 150),
    "n_estimators": randint(100, 500),
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
    "max_depth": [-1] + list(range(3, 16)),
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
}

# Randomized search
lgb = LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
rs = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=20,
    scoring="accuracy",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    refit=True,
)
rs.fit(X_enc, y)

# Print best CV accuracy
print(f"Best CV accuracy: {rs.best_score_:.4f}")
print("Best parameters:", rs.best_params_)

# Retrain on full training set (already refit) and predict on test
best_lgb = rs.best_estimator_
preds_test = best_lgb.predict(X_test_enc).astype(int)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": preds_test})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from scipy.stats import randint, uniform
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features and target
X = train.drop("admitted", axis=1)
y = train["admitted"]

# One-hot encode categorical variables
cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()
X_enc = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=cat_cols)
X_test = test.drop("admitted", axis=1) if "admitted" in test.columns else test.copy()
X_test_enc = pd.get_dummies(
    X_test, columns=X_test.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns
)
X_test_enc = X_test_enc.reindex(columns=X_enc.columns, fill_value=0)

# Set up stratified CV
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Extended hyperparameter distributions for LightGBM including regularization
param_dist = {
    "num_leaves": randint(20, 150),
    "n_estimators": randint(100, 500),
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
    "max_depth": [-1] + list(range(3, 16)),
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "reg_alpha": uniform(0, 1),
    "reg_lambda": uniform(0, 1),
}

# Randomized search with more iterations
lgb = LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
rs = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=30,
    scoring="accuracy",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    refit=True,
)
rs.fit(X_enc, y)

# Print best CV accuracy and parameters
print(f"Best CV accuracy: {rs.best_score_:.4f}")
print("Best parameters:", rs.best_params_)

# Retrain on full training set (already refit) and predict on test
best_lgb = rs.best_estimator_
preds_test = best_lgb.predict(X_test_enc).astype(int)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": preds_test})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.model_selection import (
    train_test_split,
    StratifiedKFold,
    RandomizedSearchCV,
)
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from scipy.stats import randint
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Load data
train_full = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Separate features/target
X = train_full.drop("admitted", axis=1)
y = train_full["admitted"].astype(int)
X_test = (
    test_df.drop("admitted", axis=1)
    if "admitted" in test_df.columns
    else test_df.copy()
)

# Hold‐out split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Identify numeric and categorical columns
num_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
cat_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

# Create pairwise interaction features for numeric columns
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False)
# fit on training numeric
X_train_num_inter = pd.DataFrame(
    poly.fit_transform(X_train[num_cols]),
    columns=poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols),
    index=X_train.index,
)
X_val_num_inter = pd.DataFrame(
    poly.transform(X_val[num_cols]),
    columns=poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols),
    index=X_val.index,
)
X_test_num_inter = pd.DataFrame(
    poly.transform(X_test[num_cols]),
    columns=poly.get_feature_names_out(num_cols),
    index=X_test.index,
)

# Keep only the true interaction columns (degree=2)
interaction_cols = [c for c in X_train_num_inter.columns if " " in c]
X_train_num_inter = X_train_num_inter[interaction_cols]
X_val_num_inter = X_val_num_inter[interaction_cols]
X_test_num_inter = X_test_num_inter[interaction_cols]

# Append interaction features
X_train_aug = pd.concat([X_train, X_train_num_inter], axis=1)
X_val_aug = pd.concat([X_val, X_val_num_inter], axis=1)
X_test_aug = pd.concat([X_test, X_test_num_inter], axis=1)

# One-hot encode categorical variables
X_train_enc = pd.get_dummies(X_train_aug, columns=cat_cols)
X_val_enc = pd.get_dummies(X_val_aug, columns=cat_cols).reindex(
    columns=X_train_enc.columns, fill_value=0
)
X_test_enc = pd.get_dummies(X_test_aug, columns=cat_cols).reindex(
    columns=X_train_enc.columns, fill_value=0
)

# Hyperparameter distributions
param_dist = {
    "num_leaves": randint(20, 150),
    "n_estimators": randint(100, 500),
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2],
    "max_depth": [-1] + list(range(3, 16)),
    "subsample": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
    "colsample_bytree": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0],
}

# Randomized search with 5-fold CV on training split
lgb = LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
rs = RandomizedSearchCV(
    lgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=20,
    scoring="accuracy",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    refit=True,
)
rs.fit(X_train_enc, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
best_model = rs.best_estimator_
y_val_pred = best_model.predict(X_val_enc)
val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_acc:.4f}")

# Retrain on full data and predict test set
# (refit=True means best_model is already refit on X_train_enc; fit on full if desired)
best_model_full = LGBMClassifier(**rs.best_params_, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
best_model_full.fit(pd.concat([X_train_enc, X_val_enc]), pd.concat([y_train, y_val]))
preds_test = best_model_full.predict(X_test_enc).astype(int)

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"admitted": preds_test})
submission.to_csv("./working/submission.csv", index=False)
